name: Gyan
intro: I really like to discover and build. That's why, instead of calling an API, I built a language model from scratch — every layer, the tokenizer, the training loop, all of it, on my own laptop.
now: Right now my studies come first: I'm preparing for JEE-Mains to get into college next year. Building happens around them — one project, one experiment at a time.

strong.name: Python
strong.note: my best language — Aizen is built with it

strong.name: HTML & CSS
strong.note: most of my apps and games ship with it

journey.title: First contact
journey.detail: Started coding in 7th class — and honestly, didn't like it. Writing programs felt like a chore, and I drifted away.

journey.title: The comeback
journey.detail: Years later I tried again — and this time it clicked. I became genuinely fond of building things, and the journey properly started.

journey.title: Building in public
journey.detail: One project at a time: games, study timers, a prompt library, an AR experiment, a 3D AI assistant — 11 projects, each one teaching something new.

journey.title: Aizen
journey.detail: The big one — a language model built completely from scratch in PyTorch. Two months from a character-level toy to a pretrained 16M-parameter model with its own BPE tokenizer and benchmark.

journey.title: Now
journey.detail: Preparing for JEE-Mains while keeping the builder's flame alive. College next year; the projects continue.

achievements.title: Trained a 16M-parameter LLM from scratch
achievements.detail: In a span of two months — custom Transformer, from-scratch BPE tokenizer, TinyStories pretraining, all on a MacBook. Benchmark score grew from 17% to 45.25% on a frozen 400-question eval.

achievements.title: Built and shipped 11 projects while learning
achievements.detail: Games, productivity apps, AI experiments and this OS itself — each one finished, published, and used.
